purpose: K01: map every real M16 R2A violation to the exact frozen harness function/data path M17 uses instead and the exact M17 prevention test. Derived by re-deriving values from the real repository (never copied from previous reports).

summary.eng_install_mode_mismatch: 3 ENG records record manifest.install_mode=LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV but the CURRENT frozen harness lock_install_script derives V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV from the same target manifests. The recorded value was produced by an OLDER harness runner whose lock_install_script lacked the package-mode=false distinction (returned LOCK_EXACT for any poetry+dev_group). Harness commit 25b4fbd8 (2026-09-28) added the package-mode check, changing the derived mode. M16 R2A compared current-harness derivation against the stale recorded value (record-vs-derivation), producing a false mismatch.
summary.main_dev_group_mechanism_none: 1 MAIN task (saleor-rc-f76d0093b450) declares a dev/test group in pyproject.toml (frozen dep_compiler.pyproject_dev_group_names returns 29 names) but the frozen derive_dev_test_closure on its target manifests returns mechanism=none (no lock; requirements_dev.txt exact pins are not collected by the frozen _pins_from_req_files path). M16 reused the DEV-census-gated v31_dev_closure for MAIN tasks and flagged DEV_GROUP_DECLARED_BUT_MECHANISM_NONE.
summary.root_cause_class: M16 R2A compared CURRENT frozen-harness derivations against stale RECORDED values / used a DEV-census-gated closure path for MAIN tasks. M17 removes record-vs-projection identity and derives install mode, lockfile, and dev/test closure from the frozen harness path on the same target manifests, with fail-closed ADAPTER_UNRESOLVED where frozen code cannot resolve.

violations.why_m16_failed: M16 R2A rule required 'install mode of the target manifests == recorded manifest.install_mode'. M16 derived install mode via the CURRENT frozen lock_install_script on the target manifests. For this poetry+dev_group task (poetry.lock + pyproject.toml with [tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies], NO requirements.txt, NO package-mode=false), the CURRENT frozen harness derives V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV (fallback), but the Phase-5 record was written by an OLDER harness runner (df6e1771) whose lock_install_script returned LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV for any poetry+dev_group (no package-mode check). The check compared current derivation vs stale record -> INSTALL_MODE_DIFFERS_FROM_RECORD false positive.

frozen_harness_function_data_path_m17_us.note: The historical recorded value is REFERENCE provenance only; the CURRENT frozen harness is the authority. No value is copied from the Phase-5 record.

violations.why_m16_failed: Same class as saleor-rc-939093a9c65c: current frozen lock_install_script derives V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV from the target manifests (poetry+dev_group, package-mode default true, no requirements.txt) while the Phase-5 record (produced by older runner df6e1771) recorded LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV.

Same class as the other two ENG mismatches. The older runner 6b610bbb (like df6e1771) had no package-mode check in lock_install_script and recorded LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV for poetry+dev_group; the CURRENT frozen harness derives V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV from the same manifests.

M16 derived the MAIN closure via the DEV-census-gated v31_dev_closure(task_id) path and a hand-written declares_dev_group check. For this task the frozen derive_dev_test_closure (no lock file; requirements_dev.txt exact pins not collected by frozen _pins_from_req_files because parse_requirements strips the '==' operator) returns mechanism=none while the target manifests DO declare a dev/test group (frozen dep_compiler.pyproject_dev_group_names returns 29 names). M16 correctly detected the mismatch but had no fail-closed resolution path, so it STOPPED.
